types.name: AssetConfig
docs: Token identity, oracle and risk limits for one mint.
`ltv_bps`, `liquidation_threshold_bps` and `liquidation_bonus_bps` stay in the layout for
compatibility only: V1 health uses the account-wide 1.10 threshold, and liquidation hands the
liquidator the whole account rather than a bonus.
One collateral balance swept to the liquidator (one per active collateral).
types.name: CollateralSeized
DebtPosition
docs: Borrow shares for one margin/reserve pair. Their token value grows as the reserve's
`borrow_index_wad` accrues; the share count only changes on borrow/repay.

types.name: Integration
docs: Whitelist entry for one external program a margin account may call.
Seeds: `[b"integration", program_id]`.
`adapter` picks the compiled-in validator that decides which of that program's instructions
are allowed and which margin vaults they spend from and credit to.
A whole-account liquidation: every collateral swept (`CollateralSeized`) and every debt repaid
(`DebtRepaid` with the liquidator as payer). Values are the pre-liquidation snapshot.
types.name: Liquidated
MarginAccount
docs: One isolated borrowing portfolio. Seeded only by its authority, so each wallet has exactly one
(no subaccounts).

types.name: OracleConfig
docs: How one asset is priced: its entry in the oracle facade (`oracle::get_price`), the Solana
counterpart of `OracleFacade.oracle[token]` in the Solidity protocol.
price = the Scope chain (primary), or while that is stale, Pyth price × Pyth factor (fallback),
then × the klend reserve's cToken exchange rate for Kamino receipts.
Every account is pinned here, so a transaction can never substitute another one. An unused
source is `Pubkey::default()` (accounts) or all-`SCOPE_CHAIN_UNUSED` (chains).

fields.name: scope_prices
docs: Kamino Scope `OraclePrices` account.

fields.name: scope_chain
docs: Price = product of these Scope entries, in order (e.g. JitoSOL = stake rate × SOL/USD).

fields.name: scope_twap_chain
docs: The same price's TWAP / EMA as a chain, for the divergence check.

fields.name: pyth_price
docs: Pyth push (shard 0) price-feed account: the only source when Scope is unused, the
fallback while the Scope price is stale otherwise. Its EMA is the TWAP.

fields.name: pyth_factor
docs: Optional second Pyth feed multiplied in (JupSOL: JUPSOL/SOL rate × SOL/USD).

fields.name: klend_reserve
docs: klend reserve whose cToken exchange rate converts the underlying's price (Kamino receipts).

fields.name: klend_program
docs: Program owning `klend_reserve`.

fields.name: max_age_secs
docs: A price older than this is not fresh.

fields.name: max_twap_divergence_bps
docs: Max |price − TWAP| / price. 0 disables the check.

fields.name: max_confidence_bps
docs: Max Pyth confidence / price.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Global administration and emergency state. Never written by normal user transactions, so it
never becomes a write-lock bottleneck.

types.name: RateCurve
docs: Borrow-rate curve coefficients (WAD). See `math::interest::borrow_rate_per_second_wad`.
annual_rate = rate_multiplier * (linear_coeff * (u + u^32) + jump_coeff * u^64)

fields.name: linear_coeff_wad
docs: Weight of the `u` and `u^32` terms.

fields.name: jump_coeff_wad
docs: Weight of the `u^64` term, which dominates only near full utilization.

fields.name: rate_multiplier_wad
docs: Overall scale applied to the whole polynomial.

types.name: Reserve
docs: Accounting and authority for one lending pool.
